title: Quiet: below the threshold
expectation: Detector stays in Monitoring; no banner appears.

title: Brief spike: above the threshold for four minutes
expectation: Detector reaches Pending and returns to Monitoring; no alert is emitted.

title: Sustained crossing: above the threshold for forty minutes
expectation: Detector qualifies an episode after the persistence window and shows one banner.

title: Fluctuating inside the hysteresis band
expectation: A qualified episode stays active while readings sit between 475 and 500 km/s.

title: Feed outage during an active episode
expectation: Evaluation pauses with the episode retained; the outage never reads as the storm ending.

title: Clearance and a second crossing
expectation: The episode clears on evidence, then a new crossing opens a distinct episode.
